persons.name: Mohana
persons.evidence: ramyaṃ gāruṇakaṃ purāṇam alikhat dhyāyan vibhumohanaḥ

notes: The scribe's name appears in verse in sandhi: 'dhyāyan vibhuṃ mohanaḥ' ('meditating on the Lord, Mohana [wrote]'), which could also be read as Vibhumohana. The chronogram in the verse gives netra-ākāśa-gaja = 802. Note that the verse mentions 'budhe' (Wednesday) or a related context, while the prose gloss states 'somavāsare' (Monday).
